subject: Divergence in results produced by makeADFun in RTMB and the glmmTMB package

messages.author: c819302022c3718a
messages.subject: Divergence in results produced by makeADFun in RTMB and the glmmTMB package
parts:
Hi everyone,

I encountered a problem where I have different estimates and standard errors produced by makeADFun in RTMB and nlminb and by the glmmTMB package. The divergence in the estimated variance of the random effects was quite substantial for the hurdle model in my simulation. My R code for simulation is attached here. If someone could let me know whether I did something wrong or point something to help me understand why that would be the case, I would really appreciate it.

Many thanks,
Jiachen

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Divergence in results produced by makeADFun in RTMB and the glmmTMB package
parts:
The main issue is with how you set up your Z matrix, which doesn't
match what glmmTMB does. See attached (modified) file. Basically, I set up

id2 <- rep(1:20, each = 50)
Z <- model.matrix(~0 + factor(id2))

(and made u0, u1 length-20 rather than length-19).

for n observations and k group, Z is an nxk matrix, not an (n-1)xk matrix.

Once I do this, the results match quite well.

For what it's worth, you might be able to use
glmmTMB::dtruncated_poisson() in your likelihood function rather than
writing it out yourself ...

cheers
Ben Bolker
